articles.summary: Session to be Livestreamed on the Bitcoin Magazine YouTube Channel Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI) today announced that Chief Executive Officer Raphael Zagury will speak at Bitcoin Asia 2026, taking place August 27–28, 2026 at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Hong Kong. Mr. Zagury will present a session titled “Here Be Dragons: Bitcoin’s First Ever Hashrate Bear Market” on the Nakamoto Stage on Friday, August 28 at 11:25 a.m. Hong Kong Time (11:25 p.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, August 27). The session will examine the forces behind the current mining reset and what it means for miners, investors, decentralization, and Bitcoin’s long-term security model. Bitcoin Asia 2026 Details Dates: August 27–28, 2026 Venue: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, Hong Kong Session: “Here Be Dragons: Bitcoin’s First Ever Hashrate Bear Market” Speaker: Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer, Twenty One Capital Date and Time: Friday, August 28, 2026
articles.title: Twenty One Capital CEO Raphael Zagury to Speak at Bitcoin Asia 2026 in Hong Kong

articles.summary: Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI” or the “Company”) (NYSE: XXI) today published a letter from the Company's Chief Executive Officer, Raphael Zagury. Dear Shareholders, Today we released our second-quarter results. And while I encourage you to take a look at our latest 10-Q filing to learn about what happened during the quarter, this letter to shareholders speaks to something more fundamental about the company I now lead as CEO: what you own, why it matters, and what we intend to do to improve operational opportunities and increase shareholder value. Many of you reached out over the past few weeks with questions. Some were about the company. Others were about Bitcoin itself. To answer them properly, I should probably start with why I am here. Growing up in Brazil, I watched my mother race through a grocery store because prices could change more than once a day. I learned early on what broken money does to families, and I have dedicated my life’s work to solving that issue
articles.title: Twenty One Capital Issues Letter from CEO, Raphael Zagury
